svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Checkout sends the order with a stable idempotency key.
Order state and its event commit in one database transaction.
The outbox relay publishes without risking a lost event.
Payment authorization and stock reservation run independently.
Both consumers emit durable outcomes keyed by order id.
A projector feeds both outcomes back to the order service.
State advances only after both prerequisites arrive.
A single readiness event creates the shipping label.
A redelivered event is harmless because consumers record handled ids.
A transient gateway timeout leaves the message unacknowledged.
The bus retries with backoff while preserving the order id.
Repeated failure moves the event to an inspectable dead-letter queue.
If stock failed after payment, compensation voids the authorization.
The cancellation outcome flows back to the order service.
The order records a final, auditable cancellation state.
